feed.title: Get Out Now: aliyah guides
feed.subtitle: Plain-language guides to the Law of Return, aliyah documents and emergency aliyah.

entry.title: Is there a Nefesh B'Nefesh or Jewish Agency emergency registry?
entry.summary: What exists today (aliyah applications, the Jewish Agency questionnaire) and what our petition asks for: a national registry to pre-verify Law of Return eligibility.

entry.title: Law of Return eligibility: who can make aliyah?
entry.summary: Who is eligible to make aliyah under Israel's Law of Return, 1950: Jews, children and grandchildren of Jews, and spouses, plus the exceptions in the law.

entry.title: How to make aliyah faster
entry.summary: The official aliyah steps, the documents the Jewish Agency asks for, and practical ways to avoid delays. The process usually takes 3 to 6 months.

entry.title: Emergency aliyah: how it works today
entry.summary: What emergency aliyah means, how the Jewish Agency expedited aliyah during the 2022 Ukraine crisis, what to do if you are in danger, and what a registry would change.

entry.title: Aliyah from France, the UK, the US and Canada
entry.summary: Who handles your aliyah file depends on where you live: Nefesh B'Nefesh for the US and Canada, the Jewish Agency for the UK, France and most other countries.
